entries.purpose: Add a domain or suffix to Direct/RU domain config and refresh dnsmasq rendering.
entries.nftables_iprule_behavior: No direct nft/ip rule writes observed, but it calls v7-direct-render-dnsmasq and restarts dnsmasq.
entries.temp_backup_behavior: Creates a timestamped backup of domains.conf before appending.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only; do not execute against live Direct/RU config.
entries.special_safety_notes: Live execution changes Direct/RU domain policy and restarts dnsmasq.

entries.purpose: Remove a domain or suffix from Direct/RU domain config and refresh dnsmasq rendering.
entries.nftables_iprule_behavior: No direct nft/ip rule writes observed, but it calls v7-direct-render-dnsmasq and restarts dnsmasq.
entries.temp_backup_behavior: Creates a timestamped backup and temporary filtered domains file.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only; do not execute against live Direct/RU config.
entries.special_safety_notes: Live execution changes Direct/RU domain policy and restarts dnsmasq.

entries.purpose: Synchronize Direct/RU domains from base entries and policy direct domain file, render dnsmasq when changed, and write autosync state.
entries.nftables_iprule_behavior: Does not write nft/ip rules directly; calls v7-direct-render-dnsmasq and restarts dnsmasq when domains changed; runs v7-direct-test-domain samples.
entries.trusted_ru_behavior: Can influence RU direct classification by ensuring .ru/.xn--p1ai and policy-direct entries are present in Direct/RU domain config.
entries.temp_backup_behavior: Creates domains.conf backup on first change and writes state through tmp + mv.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only; do not execute autosync against live Direct/RU state.
entries.special_safety_notes: Systemd-bound runtime-critical auto-sync. Live execution can change domain routing behavior and restart dnsmasq.

entries.purpose: Resolve policy class domain files into IP lists and write route class resolution state.
route_class_reads: policy class domain files for TRUSTED_RU_SENSITIVE, DIRECT_RU, VIDEO_OPTIMIZED, GLOBAL_FAST, GLOBAL_STABLE, LOW_LATENCY
direct_ru_reads: DNS resolution through V7_DIRECT_DNS_SERVER for policy class domains
entries.nftables_iprule_behavior: No direct nft/ip rule writes observed; output state can feed policy apply decisions.
entries.trusted_ru_behavior: Resolves TRUSTED_RU_SENSITIVE domains into route class state and can therefore influence later policy application.
entries.temp_backup_behavior: Writes mktemp state and mv's it to the route class state path.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only; do not execute against live policy state.
entries.special_safety_notes: Not read-only. It writes policy resolution state even though it does not apply routes directly.

entries.purpose: Probe Gosuslugi/Trusted RU domains across direct, browser-like direct, VLESS/SOCKS, and AWG paths and persist diagnostic state.
route_class_reads: v7-direct-test-domain policy decisions for trusted domains
direct_ru_reads: browser-like direct probes when curl-impersonate is available
entries.nftables_iprule_behavior: Reads interface availability through ip link for AWG; no nft/ip rule writes observed.
entries.trusted_ru_behavior: Gosuslugi-sensitive diagnostic. Persists trusted-ru-diagnostic.state and preserves untested existing keys; can influence operator/decision tooling downstream.
entries.temp_backup_behavior: Uses mktemp files for curl/openssl output and state assembly; mv's assembled state to /opt/v7/egress/state/trusted-ru-diagnostic.state.
entries.verification_requirement: bash -n only; do not execute live Trusted RU diagnostics in repo tests.
entries.special_safety_notes: Not read-only. It writes diagnostic state and performs live network probes against Gosuslugi/Trusted RU domains. It does not directly change route classes or apply routing.
